taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Umuokom, Etche LGA survey stations. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 156.2 | 0.60549 | 0.60549
2 | 421.4 | 0.33169 | 0.93718
3 | 2559.4 | 4.3105 | 5.2477
4 | 1032 | 30.476 | 35.724
5 | 75.659 | 10.418 | 36.766
6 | 1081.5 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation, we compare the resistivities ($\rho$) of consecutive layers in groups of three:

1.  **Layers 1-2-3**: $\rho_1 = 156.2, \rho_2 = 421.4, \rho_3 = 2559.4$
    Since $156.2 < 421.4 < 2559.4$, the pattern is $\rho_1 < \rho_2 < \rho_3$, which is **A**.

2.  **Layers 2-3-4**: $\rho_2 = 421.4, \rho_3 = 2559.4, \rho_4 = 1032$
    Since $421.4 < 2559.4 > 1032$, the pattern is $\rho_2 < \rho_3 > \rho_4$, which is **K**.

3.  **Layers 3-4-5**: $\rho_3 = 2559.4, \rho_4 = 1032, \rho_5 = 75.659$
    Since $2559.4 > 1032 > 75.659$, the pattern is $\rho_3 > \rho_4 > \rho_5$, which is **Q**.

4.  **Layers 4-5-6**: $\rho_4 = 1032, \rho_5 = 75.659, \rho_6 = 1081.5$
    Since $1032 > 75.659 < 1081.5$, the pattern is $\rho_4 > \rho_5 < \rho_6$, which is **H**.

Combining these letters in order, we get **AKQH**.

{"curve_type": "AKQH"}
